name: chat
description: Chat archiving, memorization, and compact handoff workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Archive chats, capture learnings, and preserve compact handoffs.
interface.longDescription: Chat provides workflows for synthesizing conversations into project-local archive notes, extracting durable learnings into reviewable memorize artifacts, preserving compact handoffs, and restoring active skills on session restart through Beads-backed lifecycle hooks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $chat:archive to synthesize a conversation range into a project-local archive note, $chat:memorize to extract durable learnings, $chat:before_compact to store a concise Beads handoff before compacting, or $chat:after_compact to recover context and interactively reapply relevant skills after compaction. Startup and resume hooks restore active skills separately without summarizing the previous chat.
